name: web-orchestrator
description: CLI + skill: drive web ChatGPT as a planning brain while a local Codex worker executes tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Web ChatGPT plans, Codex executes (CLI + skill, no MCP).
interface.longDescription: Uses CDP against a user-visible Chrome/Edge window with a dedicated profile to drive web ChatGPT (brain, chat quota) and a codex app-server worker (hand, Codex quota) in a bounded brain-hand loop. Exposed as a CLI (`web-orchestrator`) and a Codex skill. No API keys, no cookie reading, no CAPTCHA bypass; sign in manually. Note: running a loop sends the goal, plan, and worker output (up to ~6000 chars per round) into your ChatGPT account history — do not point sessions at code that must not appear there.
defaultPrompt: Use the web-orchestrator CLI (via skill) to run one bounded brain-to-Codex round.
